From 574bf7bbe83794a902679846770f75a9b7f28176 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kamal Dasu <kamal.dasu@broadcom.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jan 2024 16:00:32 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] spi: bcm-qspi: fix SFDP BFPT read by usig mspi read

SFDP read shall use the mspi reads when using the bcm_qspi_exec_mem_op()
call. This fixes SFDP parameter page read failures seen with parts that
now use SFDP protocol to read the basic flash parameter table.

Fixes: 5f195ee7d830 ("spi: bcm-qspi: Implement the spi_mem interface")
Signed-off-by: Kamal Dasu <kamal.dasu@broadcom.com>
Tested-by: Florian Fainelli <florian.fainelli@broadcom.com>
Reviewed-by: Florian Fainelli <florian.fainelli@broadcom.com>
Link: https://msgid.link/r/20240109210033.43249-1-kamal.dasu@broadcom.com
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/spi/spi-bcm-qspi.c b/drivers/spi/spi-bcm-qspi.c
index d96222e6d7d2..cfdaa5eaec76 100644
--- a/drivers/spi/spi-bcm-qspi.c
+++ b/drivers/spi/spi-bcm-qspi.c
@@ -19,7 +19,7 @@
 #include <linux/platform_device.h>
 #include <linux/slab.h>
 #include <linux/spi/spi.h>
-#include <linux/spi/spi-mem.h>
+#include <linux/mtd/spi-nor.h>
 #include <linux/sysfs.h>
 #include <linux/types.h>
 #include "spi-bcm-qspi.h"
@@ -1221,7 +1221,7 @@ static int bcm_qspi_exec_mem_op(struct spi_mem *mem,
 
 	/* non-aligned and very short transfers are handled by MSPI */
 	if (!IS_ALIGNED((uintptr_t)addr, 4) || !IS_ALIGNED((uintptr_t)buf, 4) ||
-	    len < 4)
+	    len < 4 || op->cmd.opcode == SPINOR_OP_RDSFDP)
 		mspi_read = true;
 
 	if (!has_bspi(qspi) || mspi_read)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/spi/spi-bcm-qspi.c`**
   - The inclusion of the header file `<linux/spi/spi-mem.h>` was removed.
   - The inclusion of the header file `<linux/mtd/spi-nor.h>` was added.
   - A condition was modified in the `bcm_qspi_exec_mem_op` function to include a check for the opcode `SPINOR_OP_RDSFDP`. This change ensures that if the operation is a read SFDP command, the `mspi_read` flag is set to true, allowing the use of MSPI reads for SFDP parameter page reads.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `spi-bcm-qspi.c` file are directly related to fixing the SFDP parameter page read failures. By changing the condition to check for the `SPINOR_OP_RDSFDP` opcode, the patch ensures that the appropriate reading mechanism (MSPI) is used when executing memory operations that involve reading the SFDP. This adjustment addresses the bug reported in the previous implementation, which did not handle SFDP reads correctly, thereby improving compatibility with parts that utilize the SFDP protocol.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (!has_bspi(qspi) || mspi_read)
    return bcm_qspi_mspi_exec_mem_op(spi, op);
```
```c
len < 4
```
```c
mspi_read = false;
```
Reason:
The `bcm_qspi_exec_mem_op` function does not set the `mspi_read` flag to true for the SFDP read command (`SPINOR_OP_RDSFDP`). This results in the function incorrectly deciding to use the BSPI operation instead of the MSPI operation, leading to failures in reading the basic flash parameter table when using the SFDP protocol.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (!IS_ALIGNED((uintptr_t)addr, 4) || !IS_ALIGNED((uintptr_t)buf, 4) ||
    len < 4 || op->cmd.opcode == SPINOR_OP_RDSFDP)
    mspi_read = true;
```
Reason:
This modification adds a condition to set the `mspi_read` flag to true when the operation is an SFDP read (`SPINOR_OP_RDSFDP`). This ensures that the function correctly uses the MSPI read operation for SFDP commands, thereby fixing the read failures associated with the basic flash parameter table.
